Swalot

Poison

Hoenn · Generation 3

Swalot is a Poison-type Poison Bag Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1.7 m tall and weighs 80 kg. It evolves from Gulpin. Its highest base stat is HP (100), with a base stat total of 467.
